verdict.rationale: Authoring custom elements is a fair axis for a UI framework, but nothing in the evidence pack documents Vue producing standards-based web components. vue-docs-3's claim that Vue 'builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' is an adjacent statement, not this capability. The only on-topic item is a community remark lamenting that Vue doesn't use custom elements, and there is no vendor claim for it to contradict, so this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
